body:
Dear Clara,
Your website shows that Moonstone Studio offers silver necklaces and bracelets, and that every necklace arrives in a gift box with a cotton pouch.
We would like to introduce our packaging range for necklaces and bracelets, which includes cardboard jewellery gift boxes and cotton pouches, with the option of printing a logo on the gift box.
Could you please let me know whether a logo-printed gift box option would be of interest to your studio?
Best regards,
Fictional Seller
FICTIONAL Bags Company
seller@example.test
